panels.gesture: Brief sidelong glance, one brow slightly raised, jaw set and mouth closed in a flat awkward line; one bare hand rubs the back of his neck ONCE, other arm low, shoulders square. No blush or smile.

Eyes look down and away, lips compressed; one loosely closed hand briefly rests against lower chin as he considers what to say, other hand low. Guarded adult expression, not a coy mouth-covering giggle.
Direct slightly narrowed eyes, one mouth corner in an awkward dry grimace; one hand at hip, other empty hand makes a small palm-up explanatory gesture low at waist, no playful smile.

Flat rueful expression, lips parted just enough for a brief admission; one open hand raised only to lower chest with fingers relaxed in a small fair-enough gesture, other arm hangs normally. No two-palmed pleading pose.
Chin slightly lowered, eyes glance sideways, tight straight mouth; both arms crossed naturally below chest, shoulders level, visibly uncomfortable but composed, no blush.
Eyes close briefly with a small frown and tense mouth; one hand presses against the brow/forehead in restrained self-reproach, other hand low, not a dramatic swoon.

Eyes meet the unseen other person with quiet sincerity, mouth gently open while apologizing, brows mostly level; one hand flat briefly on upper chest and a small respectful nod, other hand down. No imploring eyes or smile.
Sober steady gaze and closed rueful lips, chin slightly dipped; hands loosely clasp one wrist in front at waist, elbows relaxed, neither prayer nor pleading. Composed upright adult posture.

A very small wry asymmetrical mouth corner, eyes steady and one brow raised; one thumb points briefly toward his own chest as if admitting that-one-was-on-me, other hand relaxed low. Restrained awkward humor, not flirtation.
